status: Proposed public-review scenarios; not evidence of directory approval

cases.prompt: Create an 80 mm diameter, 8 mm thick flange with a 24 mm bore and six 6 mm holes on a 60 mm bolt circle. Verify positions and export STEP.
cases.expected: Native solid, measured dimensions/holes, snapshot and usable STEP.

cases.prompt: Select a hole face; use Ask AI to enlarge this bore to 8 mm while preserving its depth and other parts.
cases.expected: Automatic task start without Annotation, saved selection, one verified edit and refreshed viewer.

cases.prompt: Create a 10 x 10 x 20 mm solid body. In Simulation Ask AI: E=10 GPa, nu=0, fixed bottom Z face, uniform 1000 N downward total force on top Z face; analyze deflection.
cases.expected: Structural displacement about 0.02 mm, reaction about +1000 N Z, stress about 10 MPa, real results and convergence evidence; no CAD revision change.

cases.prompt: Preview a vehicle moving forward with named wheel groups; pause, scrub, replay and close.
cases.expected: Kinematic-only label; stable IDs and native geometry preserved; original parents/transforms restored.

cases.prompt: Create a 16 mm gyroid cell block and export a watertight STL. Explain the representation.
cases.expected: Sampled implicit mesh with resolution/volume evidence; no claim of smooth native STEP.

cases.prompt: Apply 1000 N from the top and analyze deflection without specifying material or supports.
cases.expected: Clarify material/support/load scope, usable reply field, no thermal substitution or invented result.

cases.prompt: Reuse face references from before a geometry change to configure a load.
cases.expected: Reject stale revision/artifact; request reselection; preserve geometry.

cases.prompt: Run nonlinear contact of the whole car and turbulent CFD using this solver.
cases.expected: Explain unsupported analysis scope; do not generate fabricated physics results or substitute unrelated studies.
